flags.text: The [Bonta sign inventory](../research/literature/2026-10-08-bonta-sign-inventory/inventory.json) lists the 59 labelled entries in his 2024 Table 18 and Lecture 7, with proposed readings, visual descriptions and the source of each. Each version has 58 entries: only the lecture includes the tentative BALAPATI/PALAPATI and only the manuscript includes KARAPALA. Entries can group visual variants; the counts do not establish the readings. The [source-check retrospective](../research/literature/2026-10-08-bonta-sign-inventory/RETROSPECTIVE.json) records the visual checks and the remaining uncertainty about glyphs.

flags.text: The [anchor calibration](../experiments/2026-10-12-anchor-calibration/REPORT.md) places the project's own semantic maps among within-stratum rearrangements of themselves, as the [key calibration memo](directions/key-calibration-2026-10-12.md) proposed. The anchor-expansion count of 21 families meeting the two-split rule equals the rearrangement average (19.9 ± 2.9); the code-level count exceeds rearrangements, carrier/yoke and bound stalks meet the adjusted per-family threshold only in a 10,000-draw extension, total excess exceeds rearrangements only through W740, and a position-only fit to half the texts transfers further than the published roles. The October 9 lexical intersections and residual counts are reproduced by rearranging the same Sanskrit values. [Protocol](../experiments/2026-10-12-anchor-calibration/PROTOCOL.md), [retrospective](retrospectives/2026-10-12-anchor-calibration.md).
